approaches.title: Recursive path enumeration
approaches.summary: Uses depth-first recursion to explore every valid route from the top-left to the destination. This exhaustive strategy was marked wrong for timing out.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implements recursive down/right traversal, summing all valid paths while avoiding obstacles. Marked wrong due to TLE.

approaches.title: Two-dimensional dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Uses a grid of subproblem results, where each cell accumulates paths from its accessible top and left neighbors. This avoids repeatedly exploring the same suffixes of paths.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces recursive enumeration with a two-dimensional DP table that computes path counts row by row and returns the destination value.
